name: set_character_equipped_weapon_item_id

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetCharacterEquippedWeaponItemId passes the top value to func_0014A070 and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_0014A070 resolves the item record, uses its character-category byte at offset 2 to select a 0x74-byte character record in D_003010F8, and stores weapon_item_id at equipped-weapon offset 0x36. Command 718 get_character_equipped_weapon_item_id reads the same field. The only JP call equips item 85, the Wooden Sword, in pc01.ard.
